mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (task_id, task_name, bank_ids, description, user_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{bankIds}::jsonb, #{description}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET task_name = #{taskName}, bank_ids = #{bankIds}::jsonb, description = #{description} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
UPDATE tasks SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)

UPDATE tasks SET status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), run_started_at = COALESCE(#{runStartedAt}::timestamp, run_started_at), run_completed_at = COALESCE(#{runCompletedAt}::timestamp, run_completed_at), error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'running', run_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, run_completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'completed', run_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'error', run_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'partial_failed', run_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL)
